Select approved drugs with max_phase = 4 that have both a drug_mechanism entry and a compound_structures entry with canonical_smiles. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism and INNER JOIN compound_structures. LEFT JOIN target_dictionary to drug_mechanism to allow null target_chembl_id and target_name. Return DISTINCT rows for chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, and target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
